name: moe_lds_x_reuse
description: Stage X tile once into LDS during GEMM0, then consume it from LDS in GEMM1 to halve X HBM traffic in fused MoE gate+up
preconditions: fused MoE gate (X.G^T) + up (X.U^T) with shared X operand
LDS budget has room for one X tile (32 tokens x sub_GU inner_dim) plus ~8 KB MAX-reduction scratch
steps: During GEMM0, interleave HBM loads for G, U, and X -- write X into LDS as part of the same K-split cadence
At GEMM0 end, barrier + wait on X LDS writes so GEMM1 can read safely
GEMM1 issues HBM loads for U only (G is not needed; it is the gate), and reads X from LDS via ds_read_b128
Pick LDS stride with 8-byte padding per row to avoid bank conflicts (see asm_kernel_patterns.md)
Hold X in LDS until GEMM1 dequant is done; then the region can be reclaimed for the MAX-reduction scratch
expected_impact: halves X HBM traffic; LDS reads are ~10x cheaper than HBM reads at this access pattern
